requirements.lead_text: Discuss with your counselor the safety precautions that should be practiced when working in a theater to protect the cast and crew. Then do THREE of the following:
requirements.req_text: Discuss with your counselor the safety precautions that should be practiced when working in a theater to protect the cast and crew. Then do THREE of the following: (a) Act a major part in a full-length play; or act a part in three one-act plays. (b) Direct a play. Cast, rehearse, and stage it. The play must be at least 10 minutes long. (c) Design the set for a play or a theatrical production. Make a model of it. (d) Design the costumes for five characters in a theatrical production set in a historical time. (e) Show skill in hair and makeup design. Make up yourself or a friend as a historical figure, a clown, an extraterrestrial, or a monster as directed. (f) With your counselor's approval, help with the building and painting of the scenery for a theatrical production. (g) With your counselor's approval, design the lighting for a play; or help install, focus, color, program, and operate the lighting for a theatrical production. (h) With your counselor's approval, help install, focus, equalize, program, and operate the sound for a theatrical production. (i) Serve as the stage manager for a theatrical production. Document all cues and stage setups in your calling script. (j) Serve as musical director for a musical theater production.

requirements.req_text: Mime or pantomime any ONE of the following, chosen by your counselor. (a) You have come into a large room. It is full of pictures, furniture, and other things of interest. (b) As you are getting on a bus, your books fall into a puddle. By the time you pick them up, the bus has driven off. (c) You have failed a school test. You are talking with your teacher, who does not buy your story. (d) You are at camp with a new Scout. You try to help them pass a cooking test. The Scout learns very slowly. (e) You are at a banquet. The meat is good. You don't like the vegetable. The dessert is ice cream. (f) You are a circus performer such as a juggler, high-wire artist, or lion tamer doing a routine.

Correct the misconception: Each Scout must actively mime the specific principles and real-world steps of Mime or pantomime any ONE of the following grounded in the official Theater pamphlet.
Skip Requirement 4 until after the troop court of honor
Sign off the Blue Card without completing the practical verification
quiz_item.correct_answer: Option B - Correct the misconception: Each Scout must actively mime the specific principles and real-world steps of Mime or pantomime any ONE of the following grounded in the official Theater pamphlet.
quiz_item.explanation: Per Official BSA Theater Pamphlet, pp. 22-27, Each Scout must actively mime the specific principles and real-world steps of Mime or pantomime any ONE of the following grounded in the official Theater pamphlet.

pamphlet_excerpts: Core Standard 1 (Req 5): Explain the following: proscenium arch, central or arena staging, center stage, stage right, stage left, downstage, upstage, stage crew, flies, portal, cyclorama, stage brace, spotlight, floodlight, lighting control board, sound mixing desk, thrust staging, ground plans, and sightlines.
Field Verification Standard: Apply Theater Requirement 5 procedures using verifiable measurements, clear terminology, and the BSA EDGE method.
Safety & Policy Alignment: Follow the BSA Guide to Safe Scouting, Two-Deep Leadership, and the Buddy System during all Theater Req 5 activities.
Counselor Conference Readiness: Record concrete observations, examples, and sketches in your Theater Workbook before requesting Requirement 5 sign-off.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 5): Review the official Theater requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing Explain the following: proscenium arch, central or arena.
Execute & Document: Perform the explain task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Theater Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.
